jobs.title: Smart Mobility Hub - Tolling Technology Principal Director
jobs.description:
We Are:

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services - all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Over 500,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

You Ar
e:

A tolling technology leader with deep expertise in electronic toll collection, back-office and roadside systems, multi-lane free-flow (MLFF) technology, interoperability frameworks, and large-scale tolling modernization. You understand how to help agencies and infrastructure operators deploy, integrate, and evolve complex tolling technology platforms while balancing operational performance, financial objectives, customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity considerations. You have led significant technology portfolios, built executive relationships with agencies and vendors, developed market growth strategies, and created high-performing delivery organizations. You are a trusted advisor who can shape complex technology opportunities, mobilize multidisciplinary engineering and consulting teams, and translate tolling industry challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You combine deep technical credibility, commercial acumen, and delivery discipline with a passion for advancing safer, more efficient, and revenue-optimized tolling operations.

The Wor
k:

Lead the growth and expansion of Accenture's Smart Mobility Hub tolling technology portfolio across North America, with a focus on back-office modernization, roadside systems, and interoperability platforms.

Develop and maintain executive relationships with tolling agencies, transportation authorities, state departments of transportation, concessionaires, and infrastructure operators.

Originate, qualify, shape, and support closure of strategic tolling technology opportunities, including back-office platform replacements, MLFF deployments, interoperability integrations, and end-to-end system modernizations.

Serve as an executive sponsor and delivery advisor for complex modernization programs, providing oversight of outcomes, governance, financial performance, risk, and client satisfaction.

Lead and grow Accenture’s customer service operations technology practice within the tolling portfolio, encompassing contact center platforms, CRM systems, self-service digital channels, workforce management tools, omnichannel customer engagement, and AI-powered service automation for tolling agencies and operators.

Shape technology offerings across tolling back-office modernization (CSC, violations, collections), roadside and MLFF systems, electronic payment and account management platforms, customer service operations technology, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and AI/ML enablement for tolling operations.

Build reusable Smart Mobility Hub technology assets, reference architectures, delivery methods, accelerators, tolling platform solution narratives, and industry credentials to accelerate client pursuits.

Collaborate across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, Song, and ecosystem partners to create integrated client solutions.

Lead industry thought leadership through client forums, conferences, associations, publications, and executive roundtables.

Recruit, mentor, and develop tolling technology practitioners — including systems architects, integration engineers, and platform specialists — while strengthening succession planning and technical industry capability.

Bring disciplined portfolio management, forecasting, and operational governance to pursuits and delivery programs.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requiremen t

Here's What You Need:

A minimum of 12 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, transportation systems integration, back-office platforms, roadside technology, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

A minimum of 8 years of experience leading large-scale tolling technology modernization programs, systems integration delivery organizations, technology consulting engagements, or complex multi-vendor implementation programs.

Demonstrated experience managing executive client relationships and engaging with C-suite, agency, authority, or senior public-sector leaders.

Demonstrated experience shaping business opportunities, strategic pursuits, proposals, or market growth initiatives.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

Bonus Points If:

You have leadership of major transportation technology portfolios or multi-program delivery organizations with P&L, forecasting, margin, or cash-flow accountability.

You have hands-on experience with electronic toll collection technology, commercial or operational back-office systems, MLFF/AET roadside deployments, transponder and license plate recognition systems, interoperability protocols (e.g., E-ZPass, ETAN), violations processing, collections workflow, or revenue assurance platforms.

You have experience with public-private partnerships, concessions, design-build, or multidisciplinary system integration programs.

You have experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, computer vision, cloud-native architectures, or enterprise platforms to improve tolling technology delivery, revenue optimization, or operational performance.

You have experience leading PMO transformation, ERP adoption, enterprise governance, organizational change, or workforce development.

You have active participation or leadership in IBTTA, ITS America, AASHTO, or related transportation industry organizations.

You have advanced degree or relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager, Clinical based in United States.

This role leads two engineering teams responsible for critical clinician ordering and patient continuity experiences.

You will shape engineering health, delivery, technical direction, and team performance across both areas.

The position combines people leadership with strategic technical oversight in a fast-moving product environment.

You will partner closely with Product, Design, clinical stakeholders, and leadership to turn complex needs into effective solutions.

A strong focus on AI-native engineering, technical excellence, sustainable delivery, and career development is central to the role.

This is an opportunity to influence products that support how patients receive essential medical equipment and supplies at home.

Accountabilities

Performance Management: Set clear performance expectations, provide direct and timely feedback, conduct meaningful reviews, support promotion cases, and address performance concerns early and fairly.
Coaching and Growth: Lead multiple engineering teams and actively support career and technical development, helping tech leads and senior engineers grow their scope and ownership.
Team Execution and Delivery: Own team goals and roadmap execution, remove blockers, improve feedback loops, protect focus, and maintain effective planning, review, and work-in-progress practices.
AI-Native Engineering: Drive effective adoption of modern AI development tools, including agentic coding, repository-native tooling, MCP servers, and AI-assisted review and testing.
Product and Design Partnership: Partner with Product Managers and Designers to shape scope, balance technical investment against user value, and maintain alignment between discovery and delivery.
Strategic Technical Oversight: Review architecture decisions, conduct pre-launch risk assessments, and ensure connected product areas evolve with consistent technical direction.
Technical Shaping: Lead early technical discovery, feasibility assessments, and capacity planning across multiple roadmaps.
Engineering Engagement: Stay connected to technical execution through regular code reviews, design discussions, and incident retrospectives.
Engineering Excellence: Promote strong engineering practices through agile methodologies, test-driven development, and robust software design principles.
Stakeholder Management: Serve as a key engineering contact for Product, Design, clinical stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Requirements

Management Experience: At least 5 years of engineering management experience, including responsibility for multiple teams or management through technical leads.
Engineering Experience: At least 10 years of experience delivering production software in professional environments.
Performance Leadership: Demonstrated success developing engineers toward their next level while addressing underperformance directly and constructively.
Technical Background: Professional experience working with open source programming languages and maintaining strong technical credibility.
AI Development: Hands-on familiarity with modern AI development tooling and experience driving meaningful adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across teams.

Preferred Experience: Background in healthcare, clinical workflows, or another regulated environment is a plus.
Organizational Leadership: Experience guiding teams through management transitions or periods of structural change is desirable.
Architecture and Collaboration: Experience working within large shared codebases with clearly defined domain ownership boundaries is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
If you are currently employed at Smithfield, please log into Workday and submit your application through the Jobs Hub.

Have a seat at our table. When you join Smithfield, you become part of something special – a company that's sustainably feeding people around the world, producing good food the right way with respect for our people, animals, communities and planet. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. Apply Now!

The Value You’ll Bring

The position summary states the general nature and purpose of the job. Overall accountabilities are defined in this section.

As a Senior Regional Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the development of game-changing operational strategies and drive excellence across multiple locations. You’ll provide expert technical guidance, optimize M&E processes, and tackle key challenges to elevate plant performance. By closing skill gaps, and fostering strong cross-functional relationships, you’ll empower your team to succeed.

With your extensive expertise in fresh and packaged meat manufacturing equipment and maintenance & engineering processes, you’ll be a driving force in sustaining high-performance operations. You’ll influence key decisions, lead lower-level engineers, collaborate seamlessly with peers, and ensure plant management is equipped with the right technical insights to maintain peak operational success. Your strategic vision and leadership will be the catalyst for transforming the M&E landscape and driving consistent improvement.

What You’ll Do

The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.

Leadership & Performance Management You'll lead engineering team members to cover multiple plants to ensure optimal plant performance, overseeing Project Engineering teams and projects at all locations. Manage direct reports from diverse engineering disciplines (e.g., Reliability, Strategic, Automation and /or Project Engineering) to maintain excellence. Ensure priority projects and capital/expense plans are effectively managed and properly resourced. Guide and participate in equipment comparison tests, FAT’s/SAT’s, master plans, and research of new equipment opportunities. Oversee the effective execution of plant utilities and process discipline by collaborating with the Infrastructure Group.
Strategic Oversight & Continuous Improvement Manage an Annual Capital Budget of up to $50mm, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and resource optimization. Partner with Plant Operations and Maintenance leadership to identify opportunities and implement strategies that boost operational performance. Lead the evaluation and identification of M&E process gaps across multiple plants, driving continuous improvement initiatives. Develop and maintain a culture of improvement within M&E departments, focusing on cost savings and process optimization. Lead the refinement and enhancement of the Engineering Excellence assessment process to ensure continuous evolution and relevance.
Technical & Operational Excellence You'll also provide technical leadership, overseeing the development and implementation of production technologies and technical improvements. Ensure plant teams have the expertise and troubleshooting capabilities to effectively handle major outages and complex equipment issues. Drive clarity in engineering standards and resource scheduling, aligning performance with established processes. Develop and implement programs, policies, and practices to ensure safe, high-quality food production that meets regulatory and company standards.
Compliance & Risk Management You will ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local engineering codes and regulations by keeping M&E programs, policies, and procedures up-to-date. Lead and execute cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and transfer knowledge across the organization, maintaining high standards for Quality, Food Safety, and Safety Systems.
Employee Development & Team Leadership Lead, inspire, and develop high-performing engineering teams, providing clear direction to achieve business objectives and innovative solutions. Partner with HR to deploy leadership development opportunities, drive performance management, and build a diverse, engaged workforce. Foster a culture focused on workplace safety, open communication, empowerment, and employee recognition.

What We’re Seeking

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering or related field and 8+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
2+ years of demonstrated experience in team management/development or project leadership is required.
Ability to apply sound engineering principles to operational and design issues.
Must possess Project Management skills; Contract Administration skills; National codes and standards interpretation skills.
Proficient in engineering economics.
Proficient in AutoCAD.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
Energized by collaboration through travel to other locations. (50% of the time).

Other Skills That Make You Stand Out

Knowledge of engineering principles and techniques related to food processing and the meat industry.
Previous experience in the management of multi-million dollar projects with large scopes.
Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.
Ability to be respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and adaptability.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of their team.
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
Responsibilities include supporting the interviewing and hiring of skilled trade employees and the training of these employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, AI and data with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capability. We are uniquely able to deliver tangible outcomes because of our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Consulting, Strategy, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song. These capabilities, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners, and communities. Visit us at accenture.com.

In Technology, we work with the world’s leading organizations to build and manage the digital and AI-enabled foundations that power reinvention. Our Managed Reinvention Services (MRS) practice is rewriting the playbook on managed services—shifting clients from traditional, labor-led application management toward an AI-first, agentic operating model that reshapes tech economics and delivers measurable business outcomes at speed and scale.

You Are:

Our MRS Senior Managers are accountable owners—not coordinators. We need leaders who can run complex, multi-tower managed services accounts end-to-end, shape the agentic operating model that replaces traditional AMS delivery, and build the client relationships that turn a run contract into a long-term reinvention partnership. This is not a generalist role. You will be expected to engage CIOs and technology executives with credibility, drive compounding delivery value, and actively contribute to the growth of Accenture’s MRS business.

The Work:

As a Technology Delivery Senior Manager—Managed Reinvention Services, you will:

Own end-to-end delivery accountability — hold full P&L and outcome responsibility across multi-tower managed services accounts spanning AMS, IMS, Security, and Data & AI, driving toward committed business and technology results.

Architect and operationalize AI-first delivery models — design and implement agentic operations frameworks using Accenture’s Reinvention.AI platform and GenWizard capabilities, progressing clients deliberately along the autonomy maturity curve from human-augmented (L2) toward full autonomous operations (L4/L5).

Reshape tech economics — shift client Run spend toward Reinvention capital by systematically driving cost takeout, technical debt reduction, and throughput gains—converting efficiency savings into funded transformation.

Lead the workforce transition to agentic operations — build and evolve delivery teams composed of AI agent fleets and human SREs, define new role frameworks for the agentic era, and establish the governance and escalation model for autonomous operations.

Build and expand senior client relationships — serve as the primary technology advisor to CIOs and senior IT leadership, translating delivery performance into reinvention value and expanding the engagement scope over time.

Drive continuous modernization within the run model — embed architecture simplification, platform modernization, and resilience engineering as standing deliverables within managed services—not as separate projects.

Shape and win MRS pursuits — bring delivery credibility and operating model depth to competitive bids, contributing to solution design, commercial structuring, and MRS value proposition development across the portfolio.

Minimum of 8 years of technology delivery experience, including direct P&L ownership of large-scale application and/or infrastructure managed services accounts across complex, multi-tower environments

Designing and governing agentic or autonomous operations models (fleet orchestration, SRE frameworks, L1–L5 autonomy progression)

Outcome-based or autonomy-based commercial constructs (XLAs, shared savings, value-linked pricing)

Platform engineering, self-healing infrastructure, or AI-powered SDLC at enterprise scale

FinOps, tech value management, or run-to-reinvention capital reallocation

Crafted Highlights:   

In the role of Sr. Manager, Brewery Technology
working across the North America region, you will be part of the information technology team. You will own the design, implementation, and operations of technology solutions for multiple manufacturing sites (Brew, Pack, Warehouse, Utilities) and lead initiatives that deliver scale and standards across the North America brewery network. You are both a strategic leader and an operational driver—able to set the vision for technology excellence and execute it effectively across 4–5 brewery locations.

This position sits in our Golden, Colorado
location and reports to the Sr. Director Product Solution Owner – Manufacturing Technology
working closely with the Vice Presidents of Brewery Operations, World Class Supply Chain Pillar Leads, and cross-functional teams across North America. You will lead an organization of 15–20 people, including 4–5 Brewery Systems Managers as direct reports, and act as the “Face of IT” for multiple breweries while serving as a trusted advisor to senior operations leadership. Travel will be up to 75% for this role.

Employees identified through our succession planning process as “Ready Now” will be considered first. Those who are identified as Ready in Time or who are not formally on a succession plan will be considered in conjunction with external applicants if a “Ready Now” successor is not appointed.
